chapter: Properties of matter: elasticity, viscosity, surface tension

variants.title: Poiseuille's method: viscosity of water at 20 °C
variants.method: Capillary flow under a constant head
variants.unknown: the coefficient of viscosity of water at 20 °C
variants.note: Water at 20 °C: viscosity 1.0016 mPa·s, density 998.2 kg/m3.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, Viscosity of water 0-100 °C and Density of water

variants.title: Poiseuille's method: viscosity of water at 30 °C
variants.method: Capillary flow under a constant head
variants.unknown: the coefficient of viscosity of water at 30 °C
variants.note: Ten degrees warmer and the water is already a fifth less viscous: it runs out noticeably faster.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, Viscosity of water 0-100 °C and Density of water

variants.title: Poiseuille's method: viscosity of water at 40 °C
variants.method: Capillary flow under a constant head
variants.unknown: the coefficient of viscosity of water at 40 °C
variants.note: At 40 °C the viscosity is about two thirds of its value at 20 °C, which is why the temperature must be part of the answer.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, Viscosity of water 0-100 °C and Density of water
